goal: Let the parent Agent open the existing host-derived literal-user confirmation for the unique next canary authority wait, so users click one confirm dialog instead of typing /imm-canary-authorize and then confirming again, without accepting caller-supplied authority fields or changing native Review trust.

acceptance.assertion: The closed imm_kernel_canary tool exposes request_authorization as a no-argument orchestration op in addition to existing ordinary and assurance ops, while privileged reducer kinds remain structurally absent from the schema.

request_authorization derives at most one existing authorize operation from the Kernel projection and session-local pending Review verdict, opens exactly one shared ctx.ui.confirm dialog whose summary is host-built, and on affirmation applies through the existing /imm-canary-authorize path without accepting operation, finding, approval, or capability fields from the caller.
Cancel, timeout, abort, non-TUI, missing unique legal operation, and in-flight duplicate request_authorization paths perform zero Kernel writes and return only cancelled or blocked.

Source and packaged imm-canary-work contracts instruct the Agent to call request_authorization after awaiting_user or a Review-ready follow-up, keep /imm-canary-authorize as the manual recovery surface, and do not tell the Agent to ask the user to type the authorize command as the primary path.
